  Exam Date & Time: 11-Jul-2023 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FOURTH SEMESTER B.TECH END SEMESTER MAKE-UP EXAMINATIONS, JULY 2023  
  PYTHON PROGRAMMING [CSE 4309]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                  Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  Instructions to Candidates: Answer ALL questions Missing data may be suitably assumed  
  1)             Write a program to generate all sentences where subject is in ("I", "You") and verb is in  
  ("Play", "Love") and the object is in ("Hockey","Football").  
  
  A)        Sample Output: I Play Hockey  
  (3)  
  I Play Football  
  
  I Love Hockey etc.,  
  
  
  B)        Write a Python program which iterates the integers from 20 to 60 (both included). For  
  multiples of three print "Hi" instead of the number and for the multiples of five print  
  "Hello". For numbers which are multiples of both three and five print "bye".  
  (4)  
  Sample Output: Hello Hi 22 23 Hi Hello 26 Hi 28 29 bye  
  
  
  C)        Create a list where the values are square of numbers between 1 and 20 (both included)  
  and print the first 5 elements in the list and last 5 elements in the list.                    (3)  
  
  2)             With suitable example’s, explain the various operators available in Python.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)        Write a python program which accepts a sequence of comma separated 4 digit binary  
  numbers as its input and print the numbers that are divisible by 5 in a comma separated  
  sequence.  
  
  Sample Input: 0100, 0011, 1010, 1001, 1100, 1001                                               (4)  
  
  Expected Output : 1010  
  
  
  C)        Differentiate List and tuple structures. Write possible operations (at least three) on each  
  data structure with expected outputs obtained after performing the written operation.          (3)

  3)        What is the difference between a function and a module in Python? Illustrate pictorially.  
  Write a function named guessList(n) which returns a list of n random numbers between  
  0.0 and up to but not including 1.0 where n is provided by the user to the main program. (3)  
  A)  
  B)   Build a module named lib which converts 90 degrees to radians and the result is made  
  available in a variable x. Create a main program to access lib module to compute sin(x).  
  Show complete code for modules lib as well as for main.                                  (3)  
  
  
  C)   Construct a GUI application to take student name and branch from the user. Include a  
  button named “Print” to display the corresponding values entered from the user onto the  
  screen. Make use of only grid manager in your code and provide precise layout. Discuss (4)  
  the advantages of grid geometry manager over pack manager in this layout.  
  
  
  4)        Write Python Program to Simulate a Bank Account with Support for depositMoney,  
  withdrawMoney and showBalance Operations.  
  
  A)   i) Define the class as BankAccount and define methods as depositMoney,  
  withdrawMoney and showBalance.  
  
  ii) Demonstrate the following outputs  
  
  Rama has deposited an amount of 1000.0 Rupees.                                               (4)  
  
  Rama has a balance of 1000.0 Rupees.  
  
  Rama has withdrawn an amount of 500.0 Rupees.  
  
  Rama has a balance of 500.0 Rupees.  
  
  
  B)   Consider the following matrices of order 3x3:  
  
  $$A= ((1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 6), (7, 8, 10)) and$$  
  
  $$B = ((7, 8, 10) ,(4, 5, 6), (1, 2, 3))$$  
  
  Write a python program to perform the following using Numeric Python (numpy).  
  
  a. Add and Subtract of the Matrices ‘A’ and ‘B’, print the resultant matrix C for add  
  and D for subtract.  
  (3)  
  b. Compute the product of matrix A and B (element-wise) and print the resultant  
  matrix E.  
  
  c. Compute the sum of each column of Matrix A and sum of each row of Matrix B.  
  
  d. Sort the elements of resultant matrix E and print the resultant Matrix F.  
  
  e. Transpose the Matrix F and print the result.  
  
  
  C)   Write a python program to create a Student database with STUDENT_INFO as the only (3)  
  table. Table schema is as follows: (Name TEXT, Rank INT). Write a query to populate

  the table with students information, query to retrieve names of all students whose rank is  
  less than 30.  
  
  
  5)              Write a python program that will count the number of characters, words, and lines in a  
  file and a whitespace character separates word. Your program should prompt the user to  
  enter a filename.                                                                      (3)  
  A)  
  B)         Write a non-function python program to drop empty items from a given Dictionary.  
  
  [ Hint: Original Dictionary: {'c1': 'Red', 'c2': 'Green', 'c3': None}  
  (4)  
  New Dictionary after dropping empty items: {'c1': 'Red', 'c2': 'Green'}].  
  
  
  C)         Why the App Engine SDK comes with higher level APIs to make up for any loss  
  functionality due to the restrictions. Justify your answer.                                  (3)  
  
  
  -----End-----
